channel.title: The h5i Blog
channel.description: Design essays on boundaries, evidence, and autonomous coding work.

item.title: The environment is the sandbox
item.description: Coding agents do not execute one risky command. They operate a development environment, so that whole environment must become the security boundary.

item.title: Five tiers, five different promises
item.description: Choose coding-agent isolation by threat model: checkout separation, process confinement, L3/L4 egress control, portable containers, or a separate kernel.

item.title: A transcript is not an audit trail
item.description: Review agent-written code with evidence collected outside the agent: the patch, observed execution, denied activity, and explicit gaps in observation.

item.title: Assume the prompt injection worked
item.description: Prompt-injection defenses should bound a compromised coding agent's authority: filesystem reach, credentials, sockets, network destinations, and output.
